column1: # Original sentences for the Voice Notes speech-model benchmark (docs/BENCHMARK.md). Written for this project and
# released under CC0-1.0. Columns, separated by a tab: id, category, text. The text is both what a voice reads and the
# exact reference the transcript is scored against, so numbers are written out in words (the scorer turns digits in a
# transcript into words). Everything here is invented: names, streets and numbers are not real. DRAFT: to be reviewed.

column3: Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow morning and ask about the invoice.
Don't forget to pick up the dry cleaning before five.
Note to self: the parcel for the neighbours is behind the green bin.
Ask Sam whether the meeting on Thursday can start half an hour later.
We need milk, eggs, a loaf of brown bread, two lemons and a bag of coffee beans.
Buy dog food, batteries for the torch and something nice for Grandma's birthday.
Pasta, tomatoes, basil, parmesan and a bottle of olive oil.
Meet me at fourteen Station Road in Cambridge, the entrance is around the back.
The garage is on Mill Lane, just after the roundabout with the big oak tree.
Send the package to twenty two Baker Street, flat three, in London.
The repair will cost three hundred and forty euros, and the tyres another two hundred and ten.
Transfer fifty euros to Tom for the petrol and twelve euros for the parking.
The appointment is on the third of November at a quarter past nine.
Book the train for Friday the twelfth, leaving at seven forty in the morning.
The dentist moved my visit from Tuesday afternoon to Wednesday at half past two.
Call Doctor Okonkwo about the results and email Mrs Lindqvist the new schedule.
Tell Priya and Matteo that the keys are with Mr Van der Berg next door.
Thank Elena Kowalski for the photos from the wedding in Kraków.
Add melk, kaas and hagelslag to the list for the Belgian shop.
Book a table at the brasserie for Saturday, and ask for the croque monsieur.
Call mum back.
Fuel before Monday.
Charger is in the glovebox.

I just passed the turn for the airport and I realised that I forgot to tell Anna that the report is finished, so when I get home I need to send it, then call the client, and then go through the invoices before the weekend starts.
After the meeting I want to check the tyre pressure, drop the books at the library, buy flowers for the neighbour and still find time to cook something that is not pasta.
The code for the lock is four seven one nine, and the reference number is eight two zero five five.
Her phone number is oh seven seven double oh, nine double oh, one two three.
Um, so I think we should, uh, move the delivery to Friday, no wait, to Monday.
Okay, so, let me think, the, the report needs, um, two more charts.
Milk.
Tomorrow.
The meeting is at ten, daarna gaan we samen lunchen in the old town.
Dit is een notitie voor Peter, and please tell him the files are on the shared drive.

Short recap of the meeting we just had: we moeten de constraint herformuleren want er zijn teveel grijze zones. Achteraf moeten die opnieuw gevalideerd worden met de developers. Deadline is next Wednesday.

Before the weekend I need to do a few things. First, call the garage and ask if the car will be ready by Friday, because the brakes needed new pads. Second, order a birthday present for my sister, something small that fits in an envelope. Third, check whether the flight to Lisbon is still on time, and if not, move the taxi. And finally, do not forget to water the plants on the balcony, especially the tomatoes, because the forecast says it will be very hot.

Okay, here is the plan for next week. On Monday I drive to the office early, because the printers are being replaced and I want to be there when the technician arrives. On Tuesday there is the quarterly review at ten, and I still have to finish the slides, especially the page with the budget, which Marta sent me yesterday evening. Wednesday is for the customer visit in Rotterdam, so I need to book a parking space near the harbour and bring the samples from the storage room. On Thursday the car goes in for its annual inspection, and I should ask them to look at the noise from the rear left wheel. Friday is free, so maybe I can finally go to the bakery on the corner, buy a proper loaf, and spend the afternoon cleaning the garage, because the boxes from the move are still stacked against the wall.
